description: Search quality gate (HEIST-7, earlier PM-31). Runs on its own fixture plan (the tickets below, built in a temporary project), so it does not depend on this repository's plan. Queries avoid the exact title words. Relevant targets are fixture refs.

tickets.title: Claim a ticket so two agents do not take it
tickets.description: An agent claims a ticket before it starts; other agents see the owner.

tickets.title: Claims expire so a stalled agent does not block work
tickets.description: A claim has a lease. When it runs out, the ticket is free again.

tickets.title: heist next lists the tickets that are ready to start
tickets.description: Only tickets whose blockers are done and whose parents are not blocked.

tickets.title: Rank ready work by priority
tickets.description: Urgent and high priority tickets come first in the next list.

tickets.title: Phone layout switches between the list and a ticket
tickets.description: On small screens show one pane at a time with a back button.

tickets.title: Drag cards between status columns
tickets.description: On the board a ticket moves to another column by dragging it.

tickets.title: Board view with one column per status
tickets.description: Columns follow the statuses of the project.

tickets.title: Serve several projects from one local server
tickets.description: One process can show every registered project.

tickets.title: Project registry lists all local projects
tickets.description: Projects are registered on init and listed by heist projects.

tickets.title: Project switcher in the web UI
tickets.description: A menu in the page to change between projects without a new server.

tickets.title: Show all projects on one page
tickets.description: An overview page with the tickets of every project.

tickets.title: Short readable ticket keys like SHOP-42
tickets.description: Tickets get a project key and a number instead of a long id.

tickets.title: API returns only part of the ticket fields
tickets.description: Some callers need more fields than the ticket endpoint sends.

tickets.title: Add missing fields to the ticket API response
tickets.description: Labels, parent and relations are missing from the JSON response.

tickets.title: Include every field in the HTTP ticket payload
tickets.description: The HTTP endpoint should return the full ticket record.

tickets.title: Concurrent edits must not overwrite each other silently
tickets.description: If a ticket changed while someone edited it, the save is refused.

tickets.title: Detect a ticket that changed during editing
tickets.description: Compare the version the editor loaded with the stored version.

tickets.title: Optimistic locking on ticket update
tickets.description: Updates carry the version they were based on.

tickets.title: Windows line endings break documents
tickets.description: Markdown documents with CRLF lines are parsed wrongly.

tickets.title: Detect breaking changes in API contracts
tickets.description: A check fails when a field a consumer relies on disappears.

tickets.title: Keyboard and screen reader operation
tickets.description: Every action in the web UI works without a mouse and is announced.

tickets.title: Accessible focus handling in dialogs
tickets.description: Focus moves into the dialog and returns when it closes.

tickets.title: Large trees with thousands of tickets are slow
tickets.description: The roadmap and the tree need seconds for big plans.

tickets.title: Speed up the roadmap for big plans
tickets.description: Load only the visible part of a large plan.

tickets.title: A parent cannot be done before its children
tickets.description: Finishing a parent with open children is refused unless forced.

tickets.title: Checklist for a site header: logo, menu, search
tickets.description: What a header needs: a logo, a burger menu on mobile and a search field.

tickets.title: Export an invoice as PDF
tickets.description: Invoices can be downloaded as a PDF file.

tickets.title: Dark mode colour tokens
tickets.description: Colours for the dark theme of the web UI.

tickets.title: Email notification when someone comments
tickets.description: Send a message to the assignee.

tickets.title: Set up a CI pipeline for pull requests
tickets.description: Run the tests on every push.

tickets.title: Nightly backup of the database
tickets.description: Copy the store once a day.

tickets.title: Show times in the user's timezone
tickets.description: Dates in the UI follow the local timezone.

tickets.title: Icon set for the toolbar buttons
tickets.description: Consistent icons for actions.

tickets.title: Translate the interface into German
tickets.description: All labels in the UI get a German text.
